description: Get a venue's bookable calendar: each experience (seating/menu) with its price, party sizes, cancellation policy, plus the dates and times the venue is open. Tock returns the full open-date/time set; pass a date to focus the summary. Reservations are prepaid tickets — this MCP does not book; open the venue on exploretock.com to reserve.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD to center the calendar on (optional).

party_size.description: Guests — filters experiences to those accepting this size.

slug.description: Tock venue slug, e.g. "alinea" (the exploretock.com/{slug} segment).

name: tock_get_availability
